arguments.query: SELECT order_ts, typeof(order_ts) FROM orders LIMIT 3
SELECT o.status, p.method, p.payment_status, count(*) c, count(distinct o.order_id) d FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2,3
SELECT n, count(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, count(p.payment_id) n FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1) GROUP BY n

SELECT count(*) total, sum(p.method='line_pay') lp, round(100.0*sum(p.method='line_pay')/count(*),4) pct, count(distinct o.order_id) d FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025'
